prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished wide 16:9 comic illustration, page 1 of a five-page BakaFactory story. Reference images are character identity and exact established art style references, not edit targets. Match their intricate hand-drawn inked anime storybook industrial illustration, textured warm rusty metal, warm golden sunset and lavender/cyan accents. Main character BAKA-01 MUST look identical: small squat cream rectangular worn robot head, dark navy screen face with expressive cyan eyes, single antenna with pink round tip, yellow weathered torso with black hazard stripes and BAKA-01 chest plate, teal green scarf, mechanical pincer hands and red heavy boots, no humans. Scene: high-angle wide view inside a vast factory hall with enormous EMPTY floor space, but a small central warehouse is absurdly congested at its four doors with tangled conveyor lanes, piled iron plates, copper rods and gears squeezing like rush-hour commuters; whimsical material crates with anxious simple faces allowed. BAKA-01 on open foreground floor clutching an elaborate factory planning blueprint, looking bewildered at tiny crowded warehouse; a loose component comically presses its pink antenna down. The joke is huge empty factory versus hopeless door congestion. Keep character clearly recognizable, detailed industrial setting, warm funny absurd tone. No captions, speech bubbles, subtitles, borders or watermarks; story text is rendered separately by the game. Landscape framing matching references, one continuous scene.

Character must match: squat cream rectangular chipped robot head, cyan glowing expressive eyes in dark screen, single pink-ball antenna, yellow torso with BAKA-01 badge and hazard stripes, teal scarf, pincer hands and red work boots. Scene inside warehouse factory. One warehouse outlet has an absurdly luxurious tiny red carpet with velvet ropes, leading to a hungry squat industrial shaft-power furnace holding an EMPTY bowl like a diner. ONE black BIOCHAR LUMP wearing black sunglasses travels regally along its exclusive fuel conveyor/red carpet. At the other warehouse doors, gears, iron plates and copper rods in crates with simple worried faces form tightly tangled rush-hour queues. BAKA-01 acts as exhausted traffic marshal, using its pincer to stop one gear trying to sneak onto the red carpet. Strong funny visual contrast between VIP charcoal and crowded metal parts. No humans, captions, dialogue bubbles, subtitles, decorative border or watermark. Single continuous landscape scene with clear comedy, match references' character proportions and craft quality.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE finished wide 16:9 BakaFactory comic illustration, page 5. EXACT established richly hand-drawn inked anime storybook industrial style and BAKA-01 identity matching references. Warm golden sunset, worn metal, teal and lavender schematic light. BAKA-01 is a squat old cream rectangular-headed robot, cyan eyes in dark screen, pink ball antenna, teal scarf, yellow hazard-striped torso with BAKA-01 plate, pincer hands, red heavy boots. Foreground BAKA-01 unrolls a newly APPROVED factory renovation blueprint on a worktable. The blueprint and clearly imaginary violet planning projection depict small distributed pickup terminals and intake terminals scattered around a future production line: at one pickup two different material crates with simple ticket pictograms politely take turns; at one intake products approach from four directions. These proposed terminal buildings are compact square dark-steel cabinets with cyan and magenta accents. Behind robot is the real still mostly empty factory awaiting renovation. Its folding camping chair sits safely far from the central crowded warehouse with a little paper showing a clock and an exit-door pictogram clipped to its back; a bureaucratic red rejection stamp crosses that paper in the plan, subtle punchline. Robot mildly dismayed but optimistic, quiet funny ending. Do NOT show robot leaving or factory magically completed. No humans, captions, dialogue bubbles, subtitles, borders, watermarks or UI. One continuous landscape illustration, preserve same reference anatomy, scarf and boots.
